mentions.name: High-entropy outputs macroeconomic theory paper
mentions.description: A research paper proposing an update to macroeconomic theory, treating high-entropy outputs such as waste, heat, and harmful byproducts as diminishing GDP and general population health, with data-backed studies to support the claims.
mentions.problem: High-entropy outputs (waste, heat, harmful byproducts) are not accounted for as diminishing GDP and general population health in macroeconomic theory.
mentions.source_excerpt: Been working on a paper that's my attempt to add a meaningful update to macroeconomic theory, specifically around the effects of high-entropy outputs (waste, heat, harmful byproducts) as diminishing GDP and general population health.
